events.name: “Powering Performance: Electrical
events.detail: Systems in a Super-Mileage Car” In this session, you’ll uncover the electrical backbone of Garuda’s vehicle — from the battery pack and motor controller to the sensors and driver display. Through a simplified circuit flow, you’ll see how power and data keep the car running. Finally, teams will tackle real race-day scenarios, diagnosing possible electrical faults and pitching solutions like true pit engineers. Project Garuda is the official super mileage student team of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), Bengaluru. The club brings together passionate students from various engineering disciplines to design, build, and test ultra fuel-efficient vehicles. With a strong focus on sustainability, innovation, and energy efficiency, the team represents RVCE at international competitions such as the Shell Eco-Marathon, where the goal is to achieve the maximum distance on minimal fuel or energy. The club is structured into mechanical, electrical, and management divisions .

events.name: “From Screen to Street: Designing &
events.detail: Knowing the Garuda Way” In this session, participants will be introduced to the basics of CAD design and its role in Garuda’s vehicle development. They will get a live explanation of how SolidWorks is used to model real parts, followed by an opportunity to sketch and create their own chassis concepts. This hands-on experience offers a rare chance to see how digital design turns into the actual super-mileage car.

events.name: “Aerodynamics in Action”
events.detail: Step into the world of speed and efficiency! In this session, you’ll discover the basics of aerodynamics and how it shapes Garuda’s super-mileage car. You’ll take on exciting challenges — ranking vehicle shapes from most to least aerodynamic and sketching your own aerodynamic shell design on a chassis outline. The session will conclude with a mini quiz on drag and airflow, testing your knowledge and making the learning experience even more engaging.

events.name: “From Raw Material to Race-Ready
events.detail: Part” Ever wondered how raw aluminum, carbon fiber, or steel turns into a race-ready car? In this session, you’ll step inside Garuda’s build process — from chassis fabrication to shell creation. You’ll handle and compare different materials, noting their weight, texture, and strength, and learn why each is chosen for parts of the vehicle. Finally, take on a challenge: plan a fabrication sequence step by step, just like real engineers, and wrap up with a quick quiz.

events.name: Lights, Camera, Fashion!
events.detail: In this fun and interactive contest, freshers will create their own “Outfit of the Day” (OOTD) reel using their own phones during the event. Whether it’s chic, quirky, minimal, or bold — we want to see you bring your fashion personality to life. Once your reel is ready, you’ll submit it to us through a simple QR code/link provided at the venue. Our panel will review all entries and select the most creative, confident, and stylish reel to be featured on Evoke’s official Instagram page.

events.name: Step Up: Style in Motion
events.detail: Juniors will team up to create their own high-energy choreography and strut their style on the runway. To kick things off, our seniors will set the vibe with a slick 1-minute performance to spark creativity and confidence. It's your time to shine—bring the moves, bring the attitude, and most importantly, bring the style.

events.name: Design Dash:
events.detail: The ultimate speed-styling showdown where creativity is your only currency. Teams will be handed a surprise fashion theme, think "Met Gala on a Budget," "Thrift Queen Energy," or "Retro Rewind" — and a chaotic mix of thrifted clothes, fabric scraps, funky accessories, and props. You’ll have 15 minutes to style one team member into a total fashion slay using only the materials provided, no sewing, no prep, just pure imagination and vibes. The most innovative look will win the title of “ Stylist of the Day”. The Fashion Club of RVCE is the ultimate hub for style, creativity, and self-expression. From dazzling runway shows to quirky styling challenges, we bring fashion to life on campus. Our events let you explore everything from modeling and choreography to design and styling, no matter your experience level. It’s a space to learn, experiment, and shine with a supportive and stylish community. Whether you’re here to slay the stage or simply explore your love for fashion, this is your moment to own it.

events.name: Walk the talk: Runway 101
events.detail: In this fun, interactive mini runway session where fashion meets confidence! Watch our in-house models give you a glimpse of basic runway techniques, set to upbeat music and killer energy. Then, it's your turn! Freshers are invited to try a quick, coached walk, guided by our team to help you strut with style, attitude, and flair. Whether you're here to slay or just vibe, this session is all about owning your moment and feeling fabulous while doing it.

events.name: “PAINT IT FORWARD”
events.detail: Kick off the day with Paint It Forward — a creative battle where your team’s imagination meets the true spirit of NSS! You’ll get a big poster and a simple mission: draw and paint what NSS means to you. Sounds easy? Here’s the twist — resources like paints and brushes will be limited on purpose. That means you’ll need to share, cooperate, and think together, just like real-life volunteers do when serving the community. The best artwork with the most powerful concept will win, but remember — this challenge isn’t just about colors on paper... it’s about the colors you bring to society through teamwork and selflessness.

events.name: “ACT AND SOLVE”
events.detail: Act and Solve is an exciting and thought-provoking activity where each team will be given a theme like littering, discrimination, or hunger — but here’s the twist: one member of the team must act it out without speaking for 30 seconds while the rest of their team guesses the theme. Once they guess it correctly, the same team must immediately suggest a quick and practical solution to that problem. Points are awarded for both correct guesses and impactful solutions. The team with the highest score at the end wins. It’s fun, competitive, and will make you realize that sometimes silent actions spark the loudest ideas for change.

events.name: “SHOUT IT OUT”
events.detail: Rapid-Fire NSS Quiz: Shout It Out! – Get ready for a fast-paced, high-energy challenge where your knowledge and reflexes will be put to the test! We’ll throw out quick NSS and social awareness questions, and the moment you know the answer, shout it out before anyone else does. Every correct shout earns a point for your team, so stay sharp, think fast, and let your voice be heard. It’s lively, competitive, and packed with fun — the perfect way to see who’s got the quickest mind and the strongest NSS spirit!

events.name: “Link It for Good”
events.detail: Link It for Good is a fast, fun, and inspiring team challenge where your creativity takes the spotlight! The moderator will call out a random everyday object — from a water bottle to an old pair of shoes — and your team will have just 10 seconds to connect it to a meaningful NSS cause. Can you think on your feet and turn simple things into tools for change? This game proves that opportunities to serve society are hidden in plain sight — all it takes is a sharp mind, a big heart, and a little imagination!

E-Cell is a dynamic, student-led organization that fosters innovation, leadership, and entrepreneurship on campus. Functioning through five verticals—Corporate Partnerships, Events & Operations, Startup & Innovation, Media & Tech, and Marketing & PR—it creates a holistic platform for students to gain hands-on experience. From interactive workshops, pitch competitions, and techno-cultural events to inspiring entrepreneur talks, networking sessions, and collaborative projects, E-Cell empowers members to transform ideas into impact, making it a thriving hub of creativity, real-world learning, and professional excellence. With a rich legacy and numerous success stories, Alaap has been the cradle of emerging bands like Project Mishram and Dastaan, who have gone on to shine on larger stages. The club continues to blossom into a dynamic center of creativity, inspiring artistic expression, nurturing innovation, and cultivating talent. By providing a platform to hone skills, fuel passion, and celebrate the transformative power of music, Alaap remains a space where ideas flourish and lifelong connections are built.
